name: uberasm-double-jump
title: Double Jump
description:
This will give Mario the ability to perform and store multiple midair jumps.

This ASM is customizable:
-When On Ground
+Clear stored jumps
+Set to one extra jump
+Keep stored jumps

-Gain an extra jump by collectiong a custom coin
-Set the max amount of jumps mario can store
-Allow spin jumping when holding an item
-Custom jump heights (spin and normal)
